# Error in grDevices::col2rgb(colour, TRUE) : invalid color name 'butt'

I searched through the source code a bit, and I think the problem specifically has to do with the addition of the line from the tips to the labels:
ggtree(tree) + geom_tiplab(align = TRUE, linetype = NULL)
# Works!

Maybe this has something to do with function geom_segment2 (in geom_segment.R), which is called in geom_tiplab.R (line 65) only when show_segment == TRUE. I say this because geom_segment2 specifies lineend = "butt" by default. Could some part of the code somehow be trying to use 'butt' as a colour erroneously?
